decisive_items: a mass in the left cerebellomedullary cistern isodense to gray matter without calcifications
hyperintense to CSF on T1- and T2-weighted images
response.rationale: The lesion is a nonenhancing, well-circumscribed extra-axial cisternal mass with T1/T2 hyperintensity to CSF and no surrounding edema, most compatible with an epidermoid cyst among the listed options. Absent diffusion restriction is atypical, but the other candidates are more strongly contradicted by nonenhancement or location.

rejected.why: Neurofibroma typically enhances and is not the preferred nonenhancing cisternal cystic mass.
Schwannoma usually enhances strongly; absent enhancement and T2 hyperintensity to CSF are atypical.
Hemangioblastoma generally enhances and is usually intra-axial/cystic with a mural nodule; nonenhancement is a major contradiction.
Meningioma almost always enhances; lack of enhancement and lack of dural-based calcification/hyperostosis weigh strongly against it.
